Name: Neuropixels recordings in anesthetized rats (saline/LSD) with electrical stimulation
Description: Neuropixels 1.0 recordings from medial prefrontal cortex of anesthetized Sprague-Dawley rats with electrical stimulation in BLA, 24 hours after 0.2 mg/kg LSD or saline (vehicle). This study dataset collects the raw recordings (sourcedata/) together with the spike-sorting and unit-quality derivatives generated from them (derivatives/).
